newsitem.title: JAPAN: Oriental Land minimum offer price set at 5,220 yen.
newsitem.headline: Oriental Land minimum offer price set at 5,220 yen.

text.p: The minimum auction offer price for Oriental Land Co Ltd shares due to be listed on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) on December 11 is 5,220 yen, the company said on Tuesday.

The TSE said earlier that Oriental Land, which operates Tokyo Disneyland, would hold a tender on November 27 to sell 11.5 million shares, or half the total number of shares to be offered. Applications for the tender must be made on November 26.
The selling price for the remaining 11.5 million shares would depend on the outcome of the tender, it said.
It added that applications for the 11.5 million shares must be made between December 2-4, while payment must be made on December 10 for delivery the following day.
